title: Ing Alun a Memisang Daya
intro: Isipan me ing maragul a albug a tatas babo ning gabun, ing metung a Kaban a lulutang matatag, at metung a kaladua a mitagan king kilwal king kapamilatan ning pamagpili. Makagapus ya keng daya keng propeta pero makabukud ya keng kasalpantayanan, ing pigura ayni arapan ne ing tauling aus para sumake ya kabang daragul ing danum. Malyari meng abalu ing pangatau keng likod ning pamagtakwil?
clues: Aku ing anak ning metung kareng pekamaragul a propeta nang Allah, metung a pamilya ning kasalpantayanan a pinili kung lakuan.
mebie ku keng panaun ning maragul a albug, inyang ing e kapaniwalan tinakpan ne ing gabun kalupa ning danum.
E ku bisang sumake king Kaban kayabe da ring talasalpantaya inyang inaus na ku ning tata ku.
Sinabi ku king manintun kung santungan king metung a bunduk ban protektan na ku king danum.
sinabi da kanaku na alang makaprotekta keng kautusan ning Allah keng aldong ita nung ali ing lunus.
Digpa ku king alun at linub ku, at sinabi ra kang tatang ku na ali ku kayabe king keang matulid a pamilya.

arabic: وَنَادَىٰ نُوحٌۭ رَّبَّهُۥ فَقَالَ رَبِّ إِنَّ ٱبْنِى مِنْ أَهْلِى وَإِنَّ وَعْدَكَ ٱلْحَقُّ وَأَنتَ أَحْكَمُ ٱلْحَـٰكِمِينَ
verse: And Noah called to his Lord and said, "My Lord, indeed my son is of my family; and indeed, Your promise is true; and You are the most just of judges!" (11:45)
